data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedNoTimes
data.comment: Overview Speed tile headline when no parse times are stored.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedMedianFormat
data.comment: Overview Speed tile: the median per-word parse time. {0} is a duration such as "6.4 ms".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedMedianWithPercentileFormat
data.comment: Overview Speed tile: the median and 95th percentile per-word parse times. {0} and {1} are durations such as "6.4 ms".

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSpeedStoppedPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# stopped at a search limit} other {# stopped at a search limit}}
data.comment: Count sentence on the Overview Speed tile: how many words stopped at a parser search limit. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestSummaryFormat
data.comment: Overview summary of the slowest words. {0} is the list of words with their parse times.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestWordFormat
data.comment: One slowest word in the Overview summary. {0} is the word; {1} is its parse time.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewSlowestStoppedWordFormat
data.comment: One slowest word that stopped at a search limit. {0} is the word; {1} is its parse time. Stopped is the name of an outcome.

data.name: MotifApp.OverviewTimingOverrunFormat
data.value: Object timers exceed total word time by {0}.
data.comment: Overview note when the parser object timers add up to more than the total word time. {0} is the excess duration.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParsed
data.comment: Outcome word on the Try a Word page: PanGloss built at least one analysis.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSearchIncomplete
data.comment: Outcome word on the Try a Word page: the parser search stopped before it finished.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysesPattern
data.comment: Count sentence on the Try a Word page: how many analyses the trace found. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSourceRecordsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# source record} other {# source records}}
data.comment: Count sentence on the Try a Word page: how many parser records the analyses came from. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysesWithRecordsFormat
data.comment: Try a Word analyses heading when records repeat. {0} is the analysis count sentence; {1} is the source record count sentence.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParsedAnalysesFormat
data.comment: Try a Word analyses heading for a parsed word. {0} is the analysis count sentence, such as "2 analyses".

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAnalysisAttemptsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# analysis attempt} other {# analysis attempts}}
data.comment: Count sentence in the Try a Word trace summary: how many analysis attempts the parser made. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceGuessed
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part: the parser guessed the word's stem.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceOverallFormat
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part. {0} is the overall duration of the trace.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceOverallNotRecorded
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part: no overall duration was recorded.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceInParserFormat
data.comment: Try a Word trace summary part. {0} is the time spent in the parser; {1} is the overall time sentence.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceParserTimeFormat
data.comment: Try a Word line giving the recorded parser time. {0} is a duration.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceDroppedPathsPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# other path the parser tried and dropped (normal)} other {# other paths the parser tried and dropped (normal)}}
data.comment: Count sentence over the folded paths of a parsed word: other paths the parser tried and dropped, which is normal. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceAttemptsPattern
data.comment: Count of attempts shown beside a Try a Word stop group. # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceClosestAttemptsHeadingOne
data.comment: Heading over the single closest attempt on the Try a Word page.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceClosestAttemptsHeadingMany
data.comment: Heading over the closest attempts on the Try a Word page.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceMoreAttemptsCountPattern

data.name: MotifApp.TraceShowOtherFormat
data.comment: Button text on the Try a Word page. {0} is the attempts phrase.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceShowOtherRefusedByFormat
data.comment: Button text on the Try a Word page. {0} is the attempts phrase; {1} is the name of the rule that refused them.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSearchIncompleteFormat
data.comment: Try a Word search status. {0} is the reason the search stopped.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceReasonNotRecorded
data.comment: Try a Word search status: the trace kept no reason for the stop.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSearchComplete
data.comment: Try a Word search status: the parser search finished.

data.name: MotifApp.TraceSearchCompletionNotRecorded
data.comment: Try a Word search status: the trace does not say whether the search finished.
